<style id="ax-s154c">
/* ============ s154c: question-style pause points (Jonathan 2026-10-26: "let's go with the recommended type for pause
   points. let's apply to all of them."; claude/pending/PAUSE_POINT_ROLLOUT.md). One block per bait in the practice-question
   line style: bold setup (.sl), "Offered as" in caution with the baits underlined (.si.pp-off em), the deciding line on
   the accent rule (.si), the arrow to the answer in accent (.pp-a); one muted extra line (.pp-x). The deciding line and
   the answer carry .mask, so study mode hides them like a practice item's key. The container keeps its tile. */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-pause > b.pp-t{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:18px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b + .pp-b{margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .sl,.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .si,.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .pp-a{display:block}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .sl{font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink)}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .si{margin:0 0 0 3px;padding:2px 0 2px 12px;border-left:2px solid rgba(var(--acc-rgb),.28);line-height:1.45}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .sl + .si{margin-top:5px}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .si.pp-off{color:var(--caution)}
html:not([data-theme="dark"]) .brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .si.pp-off{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--caution) 86%,#000)}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-off em{font-style:normal;text-decoration:underline wavy;text-decoration-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--caution) 70%,transparent);text-decoration-thickness:1.25px;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-skip-ink:none}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-b > .pp-a{margin-top:6px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.4}
.brief.sp .sp-pause .pp-x{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:.88em;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted)}
</style>
</body>
